children: Having been notified, on October 16th, 2026, of the preliminary estimate of the consolidated net result of the KRUK Group for the third quarter of 2026, the Management Board of KRUK S.A. (the “Company”) has decided to announce the results to the public:
- estimated consolidated net profit of the KRUK Group for 3q2026 was: PLN 198m (for the period from January 1st to September 30th, 2026 was: PLN 753m);
- estimated cash EBITDA of the KRUK Group for 3q2026 was: PLN 651m (for the period from January 1st to September 30th, 2026 was: PLN 2,052m);
- estimated net debt to cash EBITDA ratio of the KRUK Group on the end of 3q2026 was: 2.7;
The above figures are subject to change.
The finally determined financial results will be disclosed in the KRUK Group’s consolidated report for the third quarter of 2026, slated for release on October 27th, 2026.

KRUK Group is a leading European player in debt management sector. The company was established in 1998 and now operates in Poland, Romania, Italy, Spain and France. KRUK is present on Warsaw Stock Exchange in Poland and is also regular issuer of bonds on Warsaw Bond Market - Catalyst.

This information is information that KRUK S.A. is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-10-16 17:10 CEST.
